name: One-Take Journey
summary: One unbroken shot: a bright white ball bounces through a chain of dark system-UI stations that react to it (sliders, notifications, checklists, buttons), the camera following tightly on a dot-grid world, then pulling far out to reveal the whole course.

palette.use: the dot grid that moves with the camera; empty slots
raised surfaces: key caps, tracks, inactive knobs
the state after the dot, sub-labels, 'now'
fills, toggles on, track fill, sent bubbles, checks (the brand's colour)
the hero ball: always the brightest thing on screen
the canvas of the light variant (then the hero is the accent)

type.emphasis: none: the stations' own words, Name · state

banned: text overlays that explain what is happening: words live inside the stations
stations that don't react to the hero
the hero leaving the middle half of the frame
glow, grain or vignette (a soft halo on the hero only during the reveal)

sources.what: skill explainer-engaging (palette, stations, hero physics, follow camera, reveal, loop seam)
